hook: 144 names, preserved in leather — after Aberfan lost its children in seconds.

sections.voiceover: 144 names, preserved in leather — after Aberfan lost its children in seconds.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of heavy leather-bound archive pages on a dark wooden table.
sections.sfx_cue: Subtle paper rustle, low ambient tone
b_roll: National Library of Wales archive room overview shot

sections.voiceover: 21 October 1966: a coal tip collapsed on Aberfan, burying a school. 116 children died.
sections.visual_cue: Archival photograph of the hillside slide scar above the village houses.

sections.voiceover: The National Library of Wales finished new Books of Remembrance ahead of July 2026.
sections.visual_cue: A bookbinder pressing fresh gold-foil lettering onto a dark memorial cover.
sections.sfx_cue: Careful bookbinding tool work, soft foil press
b_roll: National Library of Wales bindery workshop
sections.animation_cue: Slow push in on binder working

sections.voiceover: The names live on, preserved for generations.
sections.visual_cue: Close-up of the finished Book of Remembrance, gold lettering on dark leather.
